source:
@@U04104@@
We were amused at first, Sire,
at the wild confusion we discovered
when suddenly a new Emperor appeared.
Now, in order, behind false flags and
following directions, the mob
marches across the plain—
like sheep!

@@U04106@@
Gentlemen, I welcome this rival emperor,
for I feel now for the first time
that I’m the true one.
I dressed in armor only as a soldier,
but now I wear it with a higher purpose.
At every court festival,
no matter how brilliant,
I always felt a deficiency.
It was danger I lacked.
Danger.
When I tilted, I tilted at the ring,
as you advised, though in my heart
I longed to be truly jousting.
You also counseled against war.
Had I not listened,
by now I would be a hero many times over.
When I saw myself mirrored in that realm of fire,
I felt myself stamped with the seal of independence.
The fearful element pressed horribly in about me,
but it was only illusion—
a grand illusion!
I've always dreamed vaguely of fame and conquest.
I will make up now
for what I so shamefully neglected.
(HERALDS are dispatched to challenge the RIVAL EMPEROR.
Enter 浮士德 in armor, his visor half closed, along with the THREE
VIOLENT GIANTS, armed and dressed as earlier.)
translation:
@@U04104@@
起初我们很有趣，陛下，
在我们发现的疯狂混乱中
突然，一位新皇帝出现了。
现在，按顺序，在虚假旗帜和
暴民按照指示
行军穿过平原——
像羊一样！

@@U04106@@
先生们，我欢迎这位竞争对手的皇帝，
因为我现在第一次感觉到
我是真实的。
我穿着盔甲只是作为一名士兵，
但现在我带着更高的目的佩戴它。
每逢宫廷节日，
无论多么辉煌，
我总觉得自己有不足。
我缺少的是危险。
危险。
当我倾斜时，我倾斜在戒指上，
正如你所建议的，尽管在我心里
我渴望真正的比武。
您还建议反对战争。
如果我不听的话
到那时我将多次成为英雄。
当我看到自己映入那个火域时，
我感觉自己被盖上了独立的印记。
可怕的元素可怕地压在我周围，
但这只是幻觉——
一个巨大的幻象！
我一直模糊地梦想着名誉和征服。
我现在就补
因为我如此可耻地忽视了这一点。
（传令官被派去挑战对手皇帝。
身穿盔甲的浮士德上，他的面罩半合着，和三个人一起上。
暴力巨人，和之前一样全副武装、穿着打扮。）
